params.description: Automatically learn the full steering delay. The manual actuator delay is ignored while enabled.

params.label: Force Auto-Tune On
params.description: Force-enable openpilot's live auto-tuning for "Friction" and "Lateral Acceleration".
params.picker_description: Auto-tunes steering friction and lateral acceleration.

params.label: Force Auto-Tune Off
params.description: Force-disable openpilot's live auto-tuning for "Friction" and "Lateral Acceleration" and use the set value instead.
params.picker_description: Uses fixed values instead of live steering auto-tuning.

params.label: Force Torque Controller
params.description: Use torque-based steering control instead of angle-based control for smoother lane keeping, especially in curves.
params.picker_description: Uses torque-based steering for smoother lane keeping.

params.label: Always On Lateral
params.description: openpilot's steering remains active even when the accelerator or brake pedals are pressed.
params.picker_description: Keeps steering active when pressing the gas or brake.

params.label: Pause on Brake Press Below
params.description: Pause "Always On Lateral" below the set speed while the brake pedal is pressed.

params.label: Disengage AOL on Brake
params.description: Pressing the brake fully turns off Always On Lateral. Steering stays off after the brake is released until openpilot is engaged again or AOL is manually toggled back on.
params.picker_description: Keep steering off after pressing the brake until you deliberately re-engage it.

params.label: Three-Finger AOL Tap
params.description: Toggle Always On Lateral by touching the Tesla screen with three fingers. Requires the Model 3/Y Vehicle CAN add-on cable, which is detected automatically. Does not engage or cancel cruise control. Restart the device after changing this setting or the AOL brake behavior when screen taps are enabled.
params.picker_description: Toggle steering with a three-finger screen touch using the Vehicle CAN add-on cable.

params.label: Lane Changes
params.description: Allow openpilot to change lanes.
params.picker_description: Enables openpilot lane changes.

params.label: Automatic Lane Changes
params.description: When the turn signal is on, openpilot will automatically change lanes. If a vehicle is detected in the blind spot, the lane change waits until it is clear. No steering-wheel nudge required!
params.picker_description: Changes lanes automatically when the turn signal is on.

params.label: Automatic Lane Changes Only When Engaged
params.description: Require a steering-wheel nudge for lane changes while using Always On Lateral without full engagement.
params.picker_description: Requires a nudge unless full openpilot control is engaged.

params.label: Lane Change Delay
params.description: Delay between turn signal activation and the start of an automatic lane change.

params.label: Minimum Lane Change Speed
params.description: Lowest speed at which openpilot will change lanes.

params.label: Minimum Lane Width
params.description: Prevent automatic lane changes into lanes narrower than the set width.

params.label: One Lane Change Per Signal
params.description: Limit automatic lane changes to one per turn-signal activation.
params.picker_description: Limits automatic lane changes to one per signal.

params.label: Lane Change Smoothing
params.description: Controls how smoothly openpilot commits to a lane change. 10 is stock behavior; lower values produce a gentler, more gradual maneuver. 1 stretches the maneuver to ~8 seconds.

params.label: Close Gap On Lane Change
params.description: Allows for a temporary shorter follow distance behind lead so that openpilot merges smoothly out of current lane, it will allow car to accelerate as it changes lanes.
params.picker_description: Temporarily shortens the follow gap during lane changes.

params.label: Temporary Follow Distance
params.description: Follow distance to hold while changing lanes. Only applied when shorter than your normal gap.

params.label: Lateral Tuning
params.description: Miscellaneous steering control changes to fine-tune how openpilot drives.
params.picker_description: Additional settings for fine-tuning steering control.

params.label: Force Turn Desires Below Lane Change Speed
params.description: While driving below the minimum lane change speed with an active turn signal, instruct openpilot to turn left/right.
params.picker_description: Allows turn desires below lane-change speed with a signal.

params.label: Use Route Desires for Turns
params.description: Allow an active navigation route to request low-speed turn desires.
params.picker_description: Allows navigation to request low-speed turns.

params.label: Use Route Desires for Lane Positioning
params.description: Allow route lane bias only after steering torque confirms the requested direction. It never initiates a lane change by itself.
params.picker_description: Uses route-based lane positioning after torque confirmation.

params.label: Neural Network Feedforward (NNFF)
params.description: Twilsonco's "Neural Network FeedForward" controller. Uses a trained neural network model to predict steering torque based on vehicle speed, roll, and past/future planned path data for smoother, model-based steering.
params.picker_description: Uses a neural network to smooth steering torque.

params.label: Neural Network Feedforward (NNFF) Lite
params.description: A lightweight version of Twilsonco's "Neural Network FeedForward" controller. Uses the "look-ahead" planned lateral jerk logic from the full model to help smoothen steering adjustments in curves, but does not use the full neural network for torque calculation.
params.picker_description: Uses planned path data to smooth steering in curves.

params.label: Quality of Life
params.description: Steering control changes to fine-tune how openpilot drives.
params.picker_description: Adds quality-of-life steering changes.

params.label: Pause Steering Below
params.description: Pause steering below the set speed.

params.label: Turn Signal Only
params.description: Only pause steering when the turn signal is active.
params.picker_description: Pauses steering when the turn signal is active.

params.label: Lateral Resume Delay
params.description: Delay before lateral control resumes after the turn signal is turned off. Only applies when the vehicle speed dropped below half the "Pause Steering Below" speed during the turn signal. Set to 0 to disable.

params.label: Manual Turn Release
params.description: Yield during an intentional manual turn while keeping the Ford steering session ready.

params.label: Hands-Free Cluster Display
params.description: Show the hands-free assistance graphic on supported CAN-FD Ford clusters while lateral control is active. Driver monitoring requirements do not change.

params.label: Small-Curve Prediction Blend
params.description: Blend model-predicted curvature into gentle turns. 0 uses planner curvature only; 1 uses model prediction only.

params.label: Large-Curve Prediction Blend
params.description: Blend model-predicted curvature into tighter turns. 0 uses planner curvature only; 1 uses model prediction only.

params.label: Curvature Lane-Change Factor
params.description: Scale steering during high-speed lane changes.

params.label: Enable V-ASM
params.description: Camera-based adjacent spot monitoring using the driver camera. Supplements factory blind spot monitoring.
params.picker_description: Uses the driver camera for adjacent-spot monitoring.
params.disabled_reason: Configure window annotations first in Galaxy > V-Adj Spot Monitor

params.label: Confidence Threshold
params.description: Minimum vehicle-detection confidence (0.80-1.00, default 0.94). Higher values reduce false positives but may miss detections.

params.label: Smoothing Duration
params.description: Temporal smoothing duration (0.1-0.5 seconds, default 0.2). Higher values reduce flicker but add latency.

params.description: Add trailer weight to vehicle mass for tow-aware gas, brake, and conservative lateral assist. Enter the loaded trailer weight in pounds.

params.label: Conditional Experimental Mode
params.description: Automatically switch to "Experimental Mode" when set conditions are met. Allows the model to handle challenging situations with smarter decision making.
params.picker_description: Enables Experimental Mode for configured conditions.

params.label: Persist Experimental State
params.description: Keep your manual Conditional Experimental override through reboots until you manually clear it.
params.picker_description: Keeps a manual Experimental Mode override after reboot.

params.label: Below
params.description: Switch to "Experimental Mode" when driving below this speed without a lead to help openpilot handle low-speed situations more smoothly.

params.label: Below (With Lead)
params.description: Switch to "Experimental Mode" when driving below this speed with a lead.

params.label: Curve Detected Ahead
params.description: Switch to "Experimental Mode" when a curve is detected to allow the model to set an appropriate speed for the curve.
params.picker_description: Enables Experimental Mode when a curve is detected ahead.

params.label: \"Detected\" Stop Lights/Signs
params.description:
Switch to "Experimental Mode" whenever the driving model "detects" a red light or stop sign.

Disclaimer: openpilot does not explicitly detect traffic lights or stop signs. In "Experimental Mode", openpilot makes end-to-end driving decisions from camera input, which means it may stop even when there's no clear reason!
params.picker_description: Uses Experimental Mode for predicted red lights or stops.

params.label: Lead Detected Ahead
params.description: Switch to "Experimental Mode" when a slower or stopped vehicle is detected. Can make braking smoother and more reliable on some vehicles.
params.picker_description: Uses Experimental Mode for a slower or stopped lead.

params.label: Open Road
params.description: Keep Experimental Mode active on an open road after reaching the set speed when no lead vehicle is detected. This can help the model anticipate braking sooner.
params.picker_description: Keeps Experimental Mode active on open roads without a lead.

params.label: Slower Lead
params.description: Switch to "Experimental Mode" when a slower lead vehicle is detected ahead.
params.picker_description: Uses Experimental Mode when a slower lead is detected.

params.label: Stopped Lead
params.description: Switch to "Experimental Mode" when a stopped lead vehicle is detected ahead.
params.picker_description: Uses Experimental Mode when a stopped lead is detected.

params.label: Predicted Stop In
params.description:
Switch to "Experimental Mode" when openpilot predicts a stop within the set time. This is usually triggered when the model "sees" a red light or stop sign ahead.

Disclaimer: openpilot does not explicitly detect traffic lights or stop signs. In "Experimental Mode", openpilot makes end-to-end driving decisions from camera input, which means it may stop even when there's no clear reason!

params.label: Turn Signal Below
params.description: Switch to "Experimental Mode" when using a turn signal below the set speed to allow the model to choose an appropriate speed for smoother left and right turns.

params.label: Status Widget
params.description: Show which condition triggered "Experimental Mode" on the driving screen.
params.picker_description: Shows which condition triggered Experimental Mode.

params.label: Curve Speed Controller
params.description: Automatically slow down for upcoming curves using data learned from your driving style, adapting to curves as you would.
params.picker_description: Slows for upcoming curves using your driving history.

params.label: Status Widget
params.description: Show the "Curve Speed Controller" target speed on the driving screen.
params.picker_description: Shows the Curve Speed Controller target speed.

params.label: Only Without Lead
params.description: Only use Curve Speed Controller when not following a lead vehicle.
params.picker_description: Uses Curve Speed Controller only without a lead.

params.label: Calibrated Lateral Accel
params.description: The learned lateral acceleration from collected driving data. Higher values allow faster cornering.
params.picker_description: Learned cornering comfort from your driving data.

params.label: Calibration Progress
params.description: How much curve data has been collected. Normal for the value to stay low.
params.picker_description: How much curve data has been collected.

params.label: Reset Curve Data
params.description: Clear learned Curve Speed Controller data and begin training again from the default lateral acceleration.
params.confirm_message: Reset all learned Curve Speed Controller data? Training will restart from the default value.

params.label: Following Distance
params.description: The minimum following distance to the lead vehicle. openpilot blends between this value and the "Relaxed" profile as speed increases. Increase for more space; decrease for tighter gaps.

params.label: Acceleration Smoothness
params.description: How smoothly openpilot accelerates. Increase for gentler starts; decrease for faster but more abrupt takeoffs.

params.label: Braking Smoothness
params.description: How smoothly openpilot brakes. Increase for gentler stops; decrease for quicker but sharper braking.

params.label: Safety Gap Bias
params.description: How much extra space openpilot keeps from the vehicle ahead. Increase for larger gaps and more cautious following; decrease for tighter gaps and closer following.

params.label: Slowdown Response
params.description: How smoothly openpilot slows down. Increase for more gradual deceleration; decrease for faster but sharper slowdowns.

params.label: Speed-Up Response
params.description: How smoothly openpilot speeds up. Increase for more gradual acceleration; decrease for quicker but more jolting acceleration.

params.label: Acceleration Profile

params.picker_description: Chooses how quickly openpilot accelerates.

params.label: Deceleration Profile
params.description: How firmly openpilot slows down. "Eco" favors coasting, "Sport" applies stronger braking.
params.picker_description: Chooses how firmly openpilot slows down.

params.description: Lane-change behavior that mimics human drivers by anticipating and tracking adjacent vehicles during lane changes.
params.picker_description: Anticipates nearby traffic during lane changes.

params.description: How sensitive openpilot is to detecting vehicles. Higher sensitivity allows quicker detection at longer distances but may react to non-vehicle objects; lower sensitivity is more conservative and reduces false detections.

params.description: The turn-speed hack from comma's 2022 "Taco Bell Run". Designed to slow down for left and right turns.

params.label: Force Stop Distance Offset
params.description: Tune where Force Stops bring the car to rest. Positive values let the car roll further before stopping (longer stop, closer to the line). Negative values stop the car sooner (more buffer before the line).

params.label: Force Standstill State
params.description:
Keep openpilot in the standstill state until you press the gas pedal or the Resume/+ cruise button.

This applies to any engaged stop, not just red lights or stop signs.

params.label: Radar for Takeoffs

params.description: When "Disable Uploads" is enabled, allow uploads only while parked (offroad).
params.picker_description: Disables uploads while driving; allows them while parked.

params.label: Always Allow Uploads
params.description: Override upload blocks and always keep uploader enabled. Advanced use only.
params.picker_description: Keeps uploads enabled despite upload blocks.

params.label: High-Quality Recording
params.description: Save drive footage in higher video quality.
params.picker_description: Saves drive footage at higher quality.

params.label: Cellular Metered
params.description: Prevent large uploads on cellular. Turn this off to allow full/unfiltered uploads over mobile data.
params.picker_description: Limits uploads over cellular data.

params.label: Low-Voltage Cutoff
params.description: While parked, if the battery voltage falls below the set level, the device shuts down to prevent excessive battery drain.

params.label: Raise Temperature Limits
params.description:
WARNING: Running at higher temperatures may damage your device!

Allow the device to run at higher temperatures before throttling or shutting down. Use only if you understand the risks!
params.picker_description: Allows higher temperatures; may damage the device.

params.label: C3/C3X Aggressive Cooling
params.description: Runs the fan on a lower, more aggressive temperature curve: the fan ramps up sooner and reacts faster to rising temperature, keeping the device meaningfully cooler on hot days at the cost of more fan noise.
params.picker_description: Cooler-running, louder fan curve for comma 3/3X.

params.label: Use Konik Server
params.description: Upload driving data to "stable.konik.ai" instead of "connect.comma.ai".
params.picker_description: Uploads driving data to the Konik server.

params.label: Screen Settings
params.description: Settings that control screen brightness, screen recording, and timeout duration.
params.picker_description: Controls screen brightness, recording, and timeout.

params.label: Screen Brightness (Offroad)
params.description: Use automatic brightness with an adjustable offset, or Manual to set a fixed brightness while parked.

params.label: Screen Brightness (Onroad)
params.description: Choose Auto to follow ambient light with an adjustable offset, or Manual to set a fixed brightness while driving.

params.label: Keep Screen On While eGPU Loads
params.description: Keep the driving screen awake while an eGPU model loads so you can watch its status. The normal timeout resumes when loading finishes. A manual Screen Off action still works.
params.picker_description: Keep the driving screen awake during eGPU model loading.

params.label: Screen Recorder
params.description: Add a button to the driving screen to record the display.
params.picker_description: Adds a driving-screen button to record the display.

params.label: Screen Timeout (Offroad)
params.description: How long the parked screen stays awake after a touch.

params.label: Screen Timeout (Onroad)
params.description: How long the driving screen stays awake before Standby Mode turns it off.

params.label: Standby Mode
params.description: Turn off the screen after the onroad timeout. Touch and ignition changes always wake it. Choose additional wake events below.
params.picker_description: Turn off the driving screen after inactivity and choose additional wake events.

params.label: Engagement
params.description: Wake the screen from Standby when driving assistance engages.

params.label: Disengagement
params.description: Wake the screen from Standby when driving assistance disengages.

params.label: Informational alerts
params.description: Wake the screen from Standby and keep it awake while an informational alert is displayed.

params.label: Warning alerts
params.description: Wake the screen from Standby and keep it awake while a warning alert is displayed.

params.label: Critical / takeover alerts
params.description: Wake the screen from Standby and keep it awake while a critical or takeover alert is displayed.

params.label: Turn signals
params.description: Wake the screen from Standby when a turn signal is activated.

params.label: Bluetooth or steering wheel button
params.description: Wake the screen from Standby when a recognised Bluetooth, controller or steering wheel button is pressed, including buttons without an assigned action.

params.label: Developer UI
params.description: Detailed information about openpilot's internal operations.
params.picker_description: Enables developer controls and diagnostics.

params.label: Model Lateral Smoothing (s)
params.description: Developer-only model lateral action smoothing. Default is 0.10 seconds.

params.label: Model Longitudinal Smoothing (s)
params.description: Developer-only model longitudinal action smoothing. Default is 0.30 seconds.

params.label: Developer Metrics
params.description: Performance data, sensor readings, and system metrics for debugging and optimizing openpilot.
params.picker_description: Shows performance and sensor metrics for debugging.

params.label: FPS Display
params.description: Show the frames per second at the bottom of the driving screen.
params.picker_description: Shows frames per second on the driving screen.

params.label: CPU Metrics
params.description: Show CPU usage in the driving screen developer metrics.
params.picker_description: Shows CPU usage in developer metrics.

params.label: GPU Metrics
params.description: Show GPU usage in the driving screen developer metrics.
params.picker_description: Shows GPU usage in developer metrics.

params.label: Temperature Metrics
params.description: Show numerical device temperature in the driving screen developer metrics.
params.picker_description: Shows device temperature in developer metrics.

params.label: RAM Metrics
params.description: Show memory usage in the driving screen developer metrics.
params.picker_description: Shows memory usage in developer metrics.

params.label: Enable Developer Mode
params.description: Show advanced settings in Galaxy.
params.picker_description: Shows advanced settings in Galaxy.

params.label: Stinger Object Logging Beta
params.description: Collect candidate object data on the 2022-2023 Kia Stinger for validation. Logging only: this does not enable radar-based braking or change steering. Default off. Keep driving normally, stay attentive, and upload full rlogs with bookmarked observations.
params.picker_description: Read-only Stinger object validation; no braking or steering changes.

params.label: Dashboard Speed Offset
params.description: Multiplier for dashboard speed. 1x = no offset; 1.05x = 5% faster.

params.label: Use Galaxy (new) by Default
params.description: Open Galaxy (new) at the top-level Galaxy link. Turn this off to use Galaxy (old) instead. Galaxy (old) remains available at /classic and Galaxy (new) at /mobile.
params.picker_description: Serve Galaxy (new) as the default landing page.

params.label: openpilot Longitudinal Control (Alpha)
params.description: Enable openpilot longitudinal control for vehicles that support it. This replaces the vehicle's stock ACC and may disable automatic emergency braking. Changing this setting restarts the driving stack.
params.picker_description: Uses openpilot longitudinal control; may disable stock AEB.
params.confirm_message: Enable openpilot Longitudinal Control? This is an alpha feature, replaces the vehicle's stock ACC, and may disable automatic emergency braking.

params.label: Force Offroad
params.description: Temporarily switch the device to the offroad state for remote updates when the vehicle is parked. This control is only available while the vehicle reports Park.
params.picker_description: Forces offroad state while parked for remote updates.
params.confirm_message: Force the device offroad? Only use this while the vehicle is in Park.

params.label: Redneck Cruise
params.description: On supported Hyundai stock-cruise cars, use RES/SET button presses to match the cluster set speed to StarPilot's target.
params.picker_description: Matches StarPilot's target speed with Hyundai RES/SET.

params.label: Subaru Redneck Cruise
params.description: On supported Subaru Impreza-family cars, use stock Resume/Set button presses to match the cluster set speed to StarPilot's target.
params.picker_description: Matches StarPilot's target speed with Subaru Resume/Set.

params.label: Mute Turn Limit Alert Below
params.description: Mute only the sound for "Turn Exceeds Steering Limit" below this speed. The visual alert is always kept visible. Set to 0 to disable. The value uses your selected mph or km/h unit.

params.label: Camera Offset
params.description: Virtually shift the camera perspective used by the driving model. Positive values bias the model center left; negative values bias it right. Use only for development.

params.label: Lane Centering
params.description: Experimentally bias the model command toward the detected lane center. Requires two confident lane lines and remains subject to normal curvature and jerk limits.
params.picker_description: Biases steering toward the detected lane center.

params.label: Lane Center Offset
params.description: Shift the lane target left or right in meters. The controller reduces this offset automatically when the detected lane is narrow.

params.label: Pause Lane Centering On Turn Signal
params.description: Fade lane-centering correction out when a turn signal is active so it does not fight a lane change or turn.
params.picker_description: Fades lane-centering correction during turn signals.

params.label: E2E Override Strength
params.description: Choose how strongly the vision model may override lane centering when it sees a hazard.

description_steps.description: Vehicle rigidly tries to center itself rather than avoiding hazards, potholes, or road debris.
Vehicle tries to center itself and slowly adjusts away from hazards, but may react too slowly.
Vehicle provides additional space around hazards like cyclists and vehicles crossing into the lane.
Vehicle smooths out hazard avoidance, making less rapid adjustments.
Vehicle reacts to hazards recognized by the vision model as quickly as possible.

params.label: Honda PID Kp Scale
params.description: Scale the active Honda lateralTuning.pid.kpV values from openDBC. Applies live to Honda PID lateral only.

params.label: Honda PID Ki Scale
params.description: Scale the active Honda lateralTuning.pid.kiV values from openDBC. Applies live to Honda PID lateral only.

params.label: Allow Impossible Acceleration
params.description:
WARNING: This suppresses openpilot's excessive longitudinal actuation diagnostic when measured acceleration looks impossible for the requested gas/brake command.

Leave this OFF unless you are intentionally testing edge cases like shifting to neutral and understand that it can hide a real actuation problem.
params.picker_description: Hides an acceleration diagnostic; leave off unless testing.
